subject: Intro Brand Consultation Call — Two Time Slot Options (Week of Apr 13)
body:
Hi Cristian,

I'm Jordan Reeves, Account Director at Solano Creative Agency. We're looking to bring on a freelance brand identity designer to support a new client campaign launching in Q2, and your portfolio came highly recommended.

We'd love to set up a 45-minute introductory consultation to discuss the scope and see if it's a good fit. I have two windows available next week:

**Option A: Tuesday, April 14 — 3:00 PM to 3:45 PM (PT)**
**Option B: Thursday, April 16 — 10:00 AM to 10:45 AM (PT)**

Please let me know which works better for you, or if neither fits your schedule, we can look at the following week.

Looking forward to connecting!

subject: Brand Identity Files — Rescheduling Request & Updated Deadline
body:
Hi Cristian,

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to follow up on the Terraloop brand identity package — we were expecting the refined logo variants, color system update, and brand guidelines PDF by end of last week, and we haven't received them yet.

I understand you're juggling multiple projects right now, so I want to be flexible. Could we lock in Saturday, April 12 as a dedicated deep work day for you to push through the remaining files? I'd love to have everything by end of day Sunday, April 13 at the very latest so our dev team can begin implementation the following Monday.

Please confirm this revised timeline works. If there are blockers I should know about, let's get on a quick call this week.

Best,
Nina Hartwell
Brand Director, Terraloop Studio
